page.overview:
Who is Polly?

Polly would often repeat commands, as well as nautical terms. Polly learned sailing songs from Shipwreck, and was prone to including Shipwreck's name in them. Because of Polly's irritating behavior, Shipwreck would often leave her back home while away on missions. (SM 1, SM 27, YB 2)

Polly dreams she's the leader of the P.E.T.S. (Primal Emergency Tactical Squad), a sub-team of G.I. Joe composed of all the Joes' pets. In the dream, they save Shipwreck from Crystal Ball.

Polly was first seen in the Pyramid of Darkness arc, where she manages to cancel the spike and saw trap she, Shipwreck, Snake-Eyes, and Timber were caught in by reciting the pass-phrase at the Cube factory.

She is later copied during Shipwreck's torture session in "There's No Place Like Springfield."
